pages.text: Pipes have five tiers. Each tier raises the amount moved per operation and the number of filter slots and rules.$(br2)Tier 1 moves 1 item or 50 mB per operation. Tier 5 moves 64 items or 8000 mB, every tick.

Right click a pipe with a $(item)Pipe Upgrade$() to raise it one tier. Sneak while clicking to upgrade the whole connected line, up to the configured limit. Tier skipping is off unless enabled in the config.$(br2)Bridging across a short air gap needs tier 4.
